preConditions.onFailMessage: booking dev seed edge cases skipped: seeded items 910100002-910100008 were edited or are missing
preConditions.onErrorMessage: booking dev seed edge cases skipped: seeded items 910100002-910100008 could not be checked
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BookingConfiguration WHERE openingHours = '[{"dayOfWeek":1,"start":"00:00","end":"24:00"},{"dayOfWeek":2,"start":"00:00","end":"24:00"},{"dayOfWeek":3,"start":"00:00","end":"24:00"},{"dayOfWeek":4,"start":"00:00","end":"24:00"},{"dayOfWeek":5,"start":"00:00","end":"24:00"},{"dayOfWeek":6,"start":"00:00","end":"24:00"},{"dayOfWeek":7,"start":"00:00","end":"24:00"}]' AND configurationVersion = 0 AND alignToIncrement = b'1' AND slotGranularityMinutes = 15 AND incrementUnit = 'MINUTES' AND ((id = 910100002 AND timeZone = 'Europe/Berlin') OR (id IN (910100003, 910100004) AND timeZone = 'UTC') OR (id IN (910100005, 910100006) AND timeZone = 'America/New_York') OR (id IN (910100007, 910100008) AND timeZone = 'Asia/Singapore'))

changeSet.comment: Turn the fresh dev booking seed into an edge-case catalogue: give items 910100002-910100008 partial opening hours, closed weekdays, per-weekday intervals and unusual time zones, and add a few events that sit on those boundaries. Runs only while all seven items still have the seed's all-day, every-day defaults, so it never overwrites a developer's edits. Item 910100001 (double booking, all day) is left unchanged. Raw SQL bypasses Envers, so no _AUD rows are written, as with the original seed.
